answer: Every claim climbs the dawn of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the kernel re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The spiral of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
